designDecisionsAndRationale: New storage key ccusage-gauge-theme; the legacy ccusage-gauge-color-scheme key is never read because it was auto-written from prefers-color-scheme and would open light-OS users in light, breaking the dark default.
Theme applied to documentElement data-theme before first render to avoid a flash; index.html keeps color-scheme dark meta to match the default.
Theme stays per-browser in localStorage, not in server-side UI state, since a desktop webview and a browser tab may reasonably differ.
Light series colors are fixed palettes that keep dark slot hue and saturation with lowered lightness, so a model keeps the same slot index in both themes.
App icon is rendered from vector geometry at each size by a checked-in CoreGraphics script and iconutil so the binary assets are reproducible and reviewable via the script.
Menu-bar glyph stays a template NSImage drawn in black with alpha so macOS adapts it to the menu bar appearance.
intentionalTradeoffs: Icon colors are duplicated as literals in the render script because it cannot read CSS; the icon must be regenerated if --color-bg or --color-accent changes.
Icon geometry may be adjusted by up to 0.02 S for 16 px legibility, keeping the 270-degree opening, butt caps, and no-effects rule.
Menu-bar render harness and Playwright screenshots live under the git-ignored evidenceRoot instead of outside the repository; same not-committed intent as design section 6.
swiftlint on scripts/render-app-icon.swift may report No lintable files found because .swiftlint.yml includes only Package.swift, Sources, and Tests; recorded verbatim, not a failure.
Light machine and subdirectory contrast margin is narrow (about 3.13 for #a5913c).
supportedEdgeCases: Missing or throwing localStorage: read returns dark, write is dropped.
Stored value other than light maps to dark.
Only the legacy ccusage-gauge-color-scheme=light key present: theme is dark.
Menu-bar fraction clamped to [0,1]; 0 draws rail only; >=1 draws full solid ring.
Budget with unknown fraction draws a 12-to-3 o'clock solid quarter; no budget draws the vertical marker; warning state unchanged.
Unknown effort values use unranked offsets per scheme; missing effort desaturates in light as in dark.
User chartColors overrides for the active scheme are used verbatim in light.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: OS appearance changes while the dashboard is open.
Syncing the theme between the desktop webview and browser tabs.
Subdirectory series color overrides (no override path before or after).
